imagery.name: 2024 NYS Orthoimagery (plotted in-need set only)
imagery.note: Fetch 2024 ortho crops only for the plotted in-need map set (~2k nodes), never for all ~56k scored intersections. 2025 MapServer does not cover NYC; 2026 is not published. Ranking stays GIS-only.

lion.name: NYC LION Street Base Map (intersection nodes, five boroughs)

service_requests_311.name: NYC 311 faded/after-repaving line markings (lane lines and crosswalks mixed)
service_requests_311.note: Socrata default page is 100; fetch paginates with $limit/$offset/$order. Citywide.

school_zones.name: DOE school points (elementary / K-8) within 800 ft of the node

vision_zero_crashes.name: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions — pedestrian injured or killed
vision_zero_crashes.filter: citywide NYC bbox; crash_date >= 2020-01-01; pedestrians injured or killed > 0

source_versions.imagery: 2024 NYS ITS ortho (wms/2024) for the plotted in-need set. 2025 does not cover NYC; no 2026 MapServer.
source_versions.service_requests_311: NYC 311 faded/after-repaving line markings since 2020 (8590 rows, SODA paginated, citywide)
source_versions.school_zones: DOE elementary/K-8 points (990 schools, citywide, 800 ft)
source_versions.vision_zero_crashes: NYPD pedestrian injured/killed since 2020 (50625 rows, citywide)

note: Live NYC downloads fall back to committed fixtures when an endpoint fails. LION gdb is not required for tests. Scoring is a sklearn logistic ranker on GIS features; the pixel heuristic is the baseline, not a detector. 311 Line/Marking mixes lane lines with crosswalks. Candidates are intersection nodes, not crosswalk polygons. Citywide map plots a capped 'in need' subset of scored nodes.
